mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pm_stakeholder WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY (CASE influence WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'normal' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pm_stakeholder (project_id, name, role, department, influence, contact, expectations) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{name}, #{role}, #{department}, #{influence}, #{contact}, #{expectations})
